answer: Admit by random-walk intersection, SybilLimit style. An agent counts only if short random walks, started from it along signed work relationships, collide with walks started from established verifiers. Honest agents sit in a well-mixed graph, so their walks meet the verifiers' quickly. A clone farm hangs off the graph behind a narrow ridge of a few real edges, like a reef reachable through one channel. Walks entering it rarely exit, so admissions are capped by the number of attack edges, not by the number of fake names, and an umber haze of extra clones adds nothing.
